title: Avatar renders with gold 3px ring + 3px black gap
description: Open any active creator's public profile. Verify the avatar has a 3px #FFB454 ring with a 3px black gap between avatar and ring, per design tokens.

title: PRIME badge shown only when creator.isPrime is true
description: Open a creator profile whose backing user holds an active 'prime' entitlement. Verify the gold PRIME pill renders in the badge row. Open a creator without prime -- verify the pill is absent.

title: Performer badge shown for creator_role 'live' or 'both'
description: Open profiles for creators with creator_role='live', 'both', and 'content_creator'. Verify the teal Performer pill renders for 'live'/'both' and is absent for 'content_creator'.

title: Creador badge always visible on active creator profiles
description: Open any active creator's profile. Verify the pink Creador pill is always present regardless of role/tier.

title: Price shown inline next to badge row when price > 0
description: Open a creator profile with creator_price_usd > 0. Verify a gray price string renders next to the badge row. For a creator with price 0/null, verify it is omitted.

title: Stats grid shows correct Publicaciones/Seguidores/Siguiendo counts
description: Open a creator profile. Compare the 3-card stats grid values against: (a) post count via /api/public/creator/:username postCount, (b) users.followers_count, (c) users.following_count. Expected: exact match.

title: Meta row shows correct Exclusivo count with lock icon
description: Open a creator with N exclusive posts (is_exclusive=true, is_deleted=false). Verify the meta row shows a pink lock icon plus the exclusive count, matching the DB count exactly.

title: Meta row shows correct Llamadas (completed calls) count
description: Open a creator with completed bookings. Verify the meta row's completed-calls number matches COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE performer_id=creator AND status='completed'.

title: Meta row shows Miembro desde with correct month/year
description: Open a creator profile. Verify the calendar-icon text reads 'Miembro desde' plus the correct month and year, formatted from creator.memberSince (creator_enabled_at, falling back to created_at).

title: Seguir button toggles to Siguiendo optimistically
description: As an authenticated non-owner viewer, click 'Seguir'. Verify the button flips to 'Siguiendo' immediately (optimistic) and followerCount increments by 1 without waiting for the network response.

title: Follow toggle rolls back UI state on API failure
description: Simulate a failed followUser/unfollowUser call (e.g. offline). Click Seguir. Verify the optimistic UI change reverts to the prior state and followerCount is restored.

title: Unauthenticated viewer clicking Seguir redirects to /login
description: As a logged-out visitor, open a creator profile and click Seguir. Expected: immediate redirect to /login, no API call attempted.

title: Mensaje button navigates to /dm/:creatorId when unlocked
description: As a viewer who is either PRIME-tier or is themselves an active creator, click Mensaje on another creator's profile. Expected: navigates to /dm/{creatorId}.

title: Mensaje button redirects to /subscribe when DM-locked
description: As a viewer who is neither PRIME nor an active creator, click Mensaje. Expected: redirect to /subscribe instead of opening the DM thread (mirrors Profile.tsx's isCreatorDmLocked gate).

title: Action row (Seguir/Mensaje/more) hidden on own profile
description: Log in as the creator and open your own public profile URL. Verify the Seguir/Mensaje/overflow action row does not render.

title: Overflow menu opens with Reportar and Bloquear options
description: Click the overflow (more options) button. Verify a dropdown appears with exactly two items: 'Reportar' and 'Bloquear' (or 'Desbloquear' if already blocked). Clicking outside closes the menu.

title: Reportar flow requires a category before Enviar is enabled
description: Open the overflow menu, click Reportar. Verify 'Enviar reporte' is disabled until a report category radio is selected. Select a category -- button becomes enabled.

title: Reportar flow shows success state after submission
description: Select a category, optionally add details, submit. Verify a checkmark plus 'Reporte enviado' confirmation renders, and closing resets category/description state.

title: Bloquear confirmation toggles block state correctly
description: Open overflow menu, click Bloquear. Verify confirmation modal text explains the effect. Confirm -- isBlocked flips true and menu label becomes 'Desbloquear' on next open.

title: POST /api/webapp/users/follow returns updated follower/following counts
description: As an authenticated user, POST /api/webapp/users/follow with userId=creatorId. Expected: 200 success=true, isFollowing=true, followerCount and followingCount reflecting the new state.

title: POST /api/webapp/users/unfollow returns updated follower/following counts
description: As an authenticated follower, POST /api/webapp/users/unfollow with userId=creatorId. Expected: 200 success=true, isFollowing=false, followerCount and followingCount reflecting the decrement.

title: Publicaciones tab active by default
description: Open a creator profile with both public and exclusive posts. Verify the Publicaciones tab is active by default (white text, teal underline) and shows recentPosts.

title: Exclusivo tab switches content on click, shows lock icon
description: Click the Exclusivo tab (lock icon). Verify it becomes active with the same underline styling and the Publicaciones list is replaced by the exclusive teaser list.

title: Locked teaser cards hide content/media for non-subscribers
description: As a viewer who is NOT subscribed to the creator, open the Exclusivo tab. Verify each teaser card shows only a blurred fake author row, a centered lock medallion, 'Contenido exclusivo', and a subscribe prompt -- no post text or media is rendered anywhere in the DOM (the API response exclusivePosts content and media_url must be null).

title: Exclusivo tab shows full post content for subscribed viewers
description: As a viewer who IS subscribed to the creator, open the Exclusivo tab. Verify each card renders the full author row, post content/media, and like count -- not the locked teaser layout.

title: Clicking a locked teaser card opens the subscribe flow
description: As a non-subscribed viewer, click anywhere on a locked exclusive teaser card. Expected: triggers the same purchase-confirmation modal as the main Suscribirse CTA.

title: Empty states render correctly for both tabs
description: Open a creator with zero public posts -- verify the Publicaciones tab shows the empty-state message. Open a creator with zero exclusive posts -- verify the Exclusivo tab shows its own empty-state message.

title: Subscribe CTA renders teal-cyan gradient with dark text
description: Open a non-subscribed viewer's view of an unpaused creator profile. Verify the Suscribirse button background is the teal-to-cyan gradient with dark text (not the prior solid pink).

title: Ver calendario button only renders when nextAvailability exists
description: Open a creator with an active availability schedule -- verify 'Ver calendario' is present next to the call CTA in all three states (default, subscribed, paused). Open a creator with no availability rows -- verify it is absent in all three.

title: Ver calendario popover shows correct day/time/timezone and closes
description: Click Ver calendario. Verify the popover shows the creator's next availability day label, formatted time range, and timezone, reusing the already-fetched data with no extra network call. Click the close button -- popover closes.

title: Reservar llamada still opens BookCallModal correctly (regression)
description: Click Reservar llamada in each of the three CTA states. Verify BookCallModal opens with the correct pre-selected duration when triggered from a specific package card, unchanged from prior behavior.

title: postCount matches actual post count for the creator
description: GET /api/public/creator/:username. Compare creator.postCount against the count of the creator's own non-deleted top-level social_posts plus posts assigned to their channels. Expected: exact match.

title: followerCount/followingCount match users table
description: GET the endpoint for a known creator. Compare creator.followerCount/followingCount against users.followers_count/following_count directly in the DB. Expected: exact match.

title: isFollowing=true when the authenticated viewer follows the creator
description: As a user who follows creator X, GET /api/public/creator/x while authenticated. Expected: top-level isFollowing=true.

title: isFollowing=false for anonymous/unauthenticated viewers
description: GET the endpoint with no session cookie. Expected: isFollowing=false with no error, and all other fields still populate normally (softAuth degrades gracefully).

title: exclusiveCount matches is_exclusive post count
description: Compare creator.exclusiveCount against a direct count of social_posts where user_id=creator, is_exclusive=true, is_deleted=false, reply_to_id is null.

title: completedCallsCount matches completed bookings
description: Compare creator.completedCallsCount against a direct count of bookings where performer_id=creator and status='completed'.

title: isPrime=true only for an active prime entitlement holder
description: Grant then revoke a prime entitlement for a test creator, checking the endpoint before/after. Expected: isPrime flips true only while an active, non-consumed prime entitlement row exists for that user.

title: exclusivePosts teaser content/media null when viewer not subscribed
description: As a non-subscribed viewer, GET the endpoint. For every item in exclusivePosts, verify content, media_url, and media_type are null -- only id/likes_count/created_at are populated.

title: exclusivePosts teaser content/media populated when viewer is subscribed
description: As a subscribed viewer (or the creator viewing their own profile), GET the endpoint. Verify exclusivePosts items include full content, media_url, and media_type.

title: Endpoint degrades gracefully if one sub-query fails
description: Simulate a failure in one non-critical sub-query (e.g. temporarily break access to the bookings table). Expected: the endpoint still returns 200 with the affected field defaulted rather than a 500, per the per-field try/catch pattern in the handler.

title: memberSince falls back to created_at when creator_enabled_at is null
description: For a creator with creator_enabled_at set to null, verify creator.memberSince equals their users.created_at value instead of null.

title: /creators/setup renders Step 1 (Download OBS) by default
description: Clear the pnptv_studio_wizard_v1 localStorage key, navigate to /creators/setup. Expected: CREATOR STUDIO eyebrow, 'Get set up to sell' title, 'Step 1 of 5', and the Download OBS card with an external link to obsproject.com.

title: Progress bar width matches step/5 ratio
description: Step through the wizard via Next. Verify the pink-purple gradient progress bar width is exactly (step/5)*100% at each step, with a smooth transition.

title: Step dots reflect current/done/todo state and are clickable
description: Advance to step 3. Verify dots 1-2 show pink-tinted done styling, dot 3 shows the gradient current fill, dots 4-5 show dark todo styling. Click dot 1 -- wizard jumps directly to step 1.

title: Step 2 'Choose pics on my profile' navigates to /creators/content
description: On step 2, click 'Choose pics on my profile'. Expected: navigates to /creators/content, the existing Content tab where free/exclusive media toggling lives.

title: Step 3 'Choose videos on my profile' navigates to /creators/content
description: On step 3, click 'Choose videos on my profile'. Expected: navigates to /creators/content, the same tab that hosts the channel-video featured toggle.

title: Step 4 renders the creator's real channels with FREE/PAID badges
description: On step 4, verify getOwnChannels is called and each real channel renders as a row with name, description line, and a FREE (teal) or PAID (gold) badge matching its accessType -- not hardcoded mockup example rows.

title: Step 5 shows private hangout info and upsell chips
description: On step 5, verify the teal-tinted card explains the hangout is invisible/auto-populated, and four chips render: Calls, Private shows, Custom videos, Tips.

title: Back button disabled on step 1, enabled thereafter
description: On step 1, verify Back has disabled/faded styling and does nothing when clicked. Advance to step 2 -- Back becomes enabled and returns to step 1.

title: Next button label becomes Finish on step 5
description: Advance to step 5. Verify the primary button label changes from 'Next' to 'Finish'.

title: Finishing the wizard persists completion and navigates to /creators
description: On step 5, click Finish. Expected: pnptv_studio_wizard_v1 is set to done in localStorage, and the app navigates to /creators, the creator overview.

title: Wizard shows already-finished state on repeat visit
description: With pnptv_studio_wizard_v1 set to done in localStorage, navigate to /creators/setup again. Expected: shows an already-finished message with a 'Run it again' link that resets to step 1, plus a back-to-dashboard link.

title: Get Set Up to Sell nav item routes to /creators/setup
description: Open the creator dashboard sidebar. Verify a nav item labeled 'Get Set Up to Sell' is present, distinct from the existing Setup item which points to /creators/apply, and routes to /creators/setup.

title: Overview banner shows until wizard completion, then disappears
description: With the wizard not yet completed, open /creators Overview tab -- verify the 'Get set up to sell' banner renders at the top. Complete the wizard, return to Overview -- banner is gone.
